digest.component_or_area: Codex agent guidance and local development environment
propositions: Codex sessions invoke ambient Ruff and skip mypy instead of using repository-configured tooling, causing quality gate misalignment with CI.
AGENTS.md must document how to bootstrap and activate the repository virtual environment using the same workflow as Claude Code.
Prepending the worktree .venv/bin to PATH on each command ensures make lint and make typecheck use repository tooling instead of ambient tools.
The documented local development environment setup in docs/local-dev-env.md is the authoritative source for environment bootstrap.
Gerrit change 869 implements AGENTS.md guidance to make both make lint and make typecheck exit zero in the correctly configured worktree.
